note: Every approved look reference of Brix Town, in one list (ADR-0061). Files live in Art/Reference/<Category>/ and are named <Category><Subject>[_<Variant>].<ext> in PascalCase, so a name says what it is. 'locks' is what the reference decides; 'decision' the ADR and the owner's approval; 'made_by' the script that renders it; 'models' what the game is built from or measured against with it; 'status' proposed when it waits for the owner's approval; 'issues' what is seen wrong in it and not mended, for the owner to judge; 'was' the old names. 'gaps' are references a category still lacks. Tools/reference_catalog.py checks this file against the folders and writes Art/Reference/index.html; run it after any change here.

references.title: The old-town alley at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: The look of the world (the old-town alley of style test 02: matte mottled plaster and stone, soft rounded forms, W1-W8) at morning, midday and dusk; at night with the lamps on, and with them off under a full and a new moon; and by day in cloud, rain, fog and snow. No haze at midday. Rain and snow fall, puddles lie with rings where the drops fall into them, and the snow lies, only where the sky is open over them: never under the passage's roof. Only the light and the weather change between them.
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "approved" (a reference shows every setting, not one; replaces WorldLook and the alley of WorldHours; ADR-0061)
references.made_by: Tools/blender/hours_50.py (WASTED_PLACE=alley), on the alley of Tools/blender/old_town_04.py
models: Game/Source/BrixTown/Private/BrixLight.cpp and Game/Config/DefaultGame.ini [/Script/BrixTown.BrixLight] (the sun, sky, haze, the eye)
issues: The cream banners across the alley catch the gate lamp at dusk and at night and read as bright blocks.
People are lit like everything else: nobody stands out under a lamp at night.

references.title: The sky and its clouds at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: The sky over the town, seen from Market Square over the roofs: blue overhead fading to the pale haze at the horizon by day, warm towards the low sun at dusk, the night's dark blue with the town's glow low down; clouds as soft heaps on one layer about 1.2 km up, flat underneath and rounded on top, lit on the sun's side and shaded underneath, pink at dusk, lit from below by the town's lamps at night; how much of the sky they cover follows the weather (clear 0.36, cloudy 0.62, rain 0.97, fog 0.55, snow 0.92); at night the stars, the Milky Way and the full moon's disc. No planet (ADR-0062).
references.approved: proposed 2026-11-26, for the owner to review
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "move to sky and cloud system"; ADR-0014 (the sky and clouds), ADR-0023 (the night sky), ADR-0062 (no planet)
references.made_by: Tools/blender/hours_50.py (WASTED_PLACE=sky) with Tools/blender/sky_52.py, on Market Square of Tools/blender/old_town_04.py
issues: Falling snow reads as grey dots against the bright covered sky.
The lying snow is laid in 25 cm squares: their steps show where it meets the fountain's base and the stalls.
The moon's disc is set where the camera sees it, not where the moonlight comes from.

references.title: The town at morning, dusk and midday
references.locks: One place readable at every hour: the alley at morning and dusk, a market square at midday.
issues: Being replaced (the owner, 2026-11-26): the alley by WorldAlley, which has every hour; Market Square to have a reference of its own at every hour, its midday shade lit by the bounced light the approved one lacks.

references.title: The daylight on a street of kit buildings
references.locks: The daylight: softer, warmer sun, thinner haze, on real lots built by the building kit. The light the Unreal sun and sky are set by.
issues: To be replaced by a street at every hour (the owner, 2026-11-26): morning, midday, dusk and night with the lamps on and off, under a full and a new moon.

references.title: Rooms of every kind, in one shell
references.locks: How a room of each kind is furnished and lit: the kit daylight through a side window, pendants of 70 W in the lantern's colour, one camera and exposure. The game's rooms are measured against the shop, cafe and kitchen (ABrixLightRoom, Tools/unreal/light_reference.py).
references.decision: ADR-0055 (measured against); the owner, 2026-11-26: a good reference, "as it shows different settings"
issues: The rooms have three walls: the open fourth side lets in light a closed room would not have, and the game's room light was tuned to it.
The floor boards are about 1 x 2.5 m (the boards material at brick_scale 0.25): they read as flagstones.
The window is a flat pale panel: nothing of the street or the hour outside shows.
Lamp shades burn to plain white.
Brightness differs widely: the bedroom, decor, garden and study are near black in the corners, the cafe bright.
The shop, the cafe and the garden are the size of a small room.
